female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

loan-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayments predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
loan-history-faster.body: Pitches from both men and women that explicitly reference a successful track record of repaying previous loans tend to accelerate funding speed.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.body: The inclusion of specific monthly income, detailed inventory lists, or precise product types accelerates funding for both men and women.

family-mention-interaction.title: Mentioning family obligations and benefits has opposite effects on funding speed by gender.
family-mention-interaction.body: Pitches from women that highlight family or community benefits fund faster, while pitches from men that mention family obligations or school fees fund more slowly.

institutional-detail-slower.title: Mentioning local currency amounts or specific institutional affiliations predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-detail-slower.body: Pitches that include specific local currency figures or name the microfinance institution tend to experience slower funding speeds for both men and women.

child-demographics-slower.title: Providing specific demographic details about children, such as number and schooling status, predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
child-demographics-slower.body: Pitches that include precise counts of children or their specific educational status tend to decelerate funding speed for both men and women.

female-positive-adjectives-faster.body: Female borrowers who use positive descriptive adjectives like 'dynamic' or 'hardworking' may fund faster.

female-homeownership-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention owning their own home may fund faster.

female-home-based-business-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention operating their business from or near the home may fund faster.

male-external-obligations-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention external financial obligations or organizational memberships may fund more slowly.

female-fewer-children-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe having fewer children may fund faster.

female-mfi-structural-detail-faster.body: Female borrowers who explain the microfinance program's role or collateral constraints may fund faster.

male-spouse-contribution-faster.body: Male borrowers who describe the productive contribution of a spouse may fund faster.

male-income-goal-faster.body: Male borrowers who explicitly mention a desire to increase sales or income may fund faster.

female-pitch-length-slower.body: Female borrowers who write significantly longer pitches may fund more slowly.

female-husband-mention-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly mention their husband's income or business partnership may fund more slowly.

female-geographic-specificity-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific towns or districts may fund more slowly.
female-geographic-specificity-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specifying exact town or community accelerates funding for women.

female-pitch-brevity-faster.title: Female borrowers who write shorter pitches may fund faster than those who write longer ones.
female-pitch-brevity-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to maintain cap.

female-repayment-promise-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly promise prompt repayment may fund faster.
female-repayment-promise-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to maintain cap.

demographic-specificity-faster.title: Providing specific demographic details, such as age or family member employment, predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
demographic-specificity-faster.retrospective: Confidence fell below 0.35 due to evidence that mentioning children or marital status slows funding for women.

female-family-status-slower.title: Mentioning marital status or the existence of children may decelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-family-status-slower.retrospective: Dropped as least corroborated puzzle to maintain memory cap.

female-age-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age or birth year in the pitch text may experience faster funding.
female-age-specificity-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new observation regarding child details.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who include explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower.retrospective: Retired to maintain claim cap for promoted male observation.

female-child-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about children's ages or education may fund more slowly.
female-child-detail-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specifying exact age of child accelerates funding.

female-animal-business-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe animal-related businesses, such as pig or fish breeding, may fund faster.
female-animal-business-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to maintain memory cap.

male-process-detail-slower.title: Pitches from men that describe specific operational details, such as door-to-door sales or specific repair materials, tend to decelerate funding.
male-process-detail-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted child demographics claim.
